messages:
sam_ops: Heads-up — scheduling a soft maintenance window in az-north-3 next Tue 02:00–04:00 UTC. Target: rolling NIC firmware flip + graceful GPU driver restart across the compute pool.

maintenance-bot: Scheduled maintenance created (id m-azn3-2026-03-31). Auto-notify enabled.

maria_infra: ETA on capacity impact?

sam_ops: Expect ~8% capacity reduction for ~10m per rack while we cycle drivers. We'll stagger per-rack every 6 minutes to keep tail latencies low.

lee_sre: Any known networking risk? Last time we saw transient egress spikes when the ToR reannounced paths.

sam_ops: Good call — we'll enable egress shaping for 15m around each rack window and monitor egress queue depth. If queues exceed threshold we'll pause the rack and failover traffic.

tanya_eng: Can we place latency-sensitive tenants on warm standby pools during their rack window? I can kick a migration job if we have the list.

sam_ops: Yes — plan is to backfill into redwood-burst and gradient-pool-2. Tanya, can you run the migration patch for tenants flagged in the sheet?

tanya_eng: On it. I'll push a canary set first (10 tenants) and report perf.

alex_cost: Quick cost heads-up — backfilling into on-demand burst pools could add ~0.6% spend for the day. Should we pre-approve?

sam_ops: Approve for this window; we've budgeted for it in the maintenance runbook. Keep an eye on tokenized usage for large jobs.

lee_sre: Procedure reminders:
1) Drain pods with `--grace-period=120`
2) Disable GPU job scheduling via label `maintenance=true`
3) Reboot flow: unload driver -> reboot node -> validate MIG/KV cache reattach -> mark schedulable

sam_ops: Exact commands (for on-call):
```
kubectl drain node/$NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
ssh $NODE sudo systemctl stop nvidia-persistenced
ssh $NODE sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm nvidia
ssh $NODE sudo reboot
# post-reboot
ssh $NODE sudo modprobe nvidia
kubectl uncordon $NODE
```

maria_infra: We'll also run a quick telemetry agent sweep pre and post to ensure no regressions in driver telemetry.

lee_sre: Monitoring hooks: make sure synthetic perf tests run after each rack; I added a dashboard panel for pod creation latencies and egress queue depth.

sam_ops: Rollout cadence: 1 rack every 6 minutes, pause on any of: >5% error rate increase, p95 generation latency >150ms, or egress queue >85%. Fallback: shift remaining racks to az-south-1 pool and abort the rest.

tanya_eng: I found 3 tenants with long-running batch jobs during the window. I'll coordinate to drain them earlier.

alex_cost: If we hit the fallback and spill to on-demand for >30min we should notify Finance. I'll set up a spend alert at +1% above baseline for the day.

maintenance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 02:00 UTC — m-azn3-2026-03-31. Slack channel: #eng-infra.

sam_ops: Final action items: Maria — telemetry sweep script? Lee — synthetic panels + alert thresholds. Tanya — migrations for flagged tenants. Alex — spend alert. I'll own the run and comms.

maria_infra: Telemetry script pushed to ops/repos/telemetry/sweeps (v2). Link: https://git.internal/ops/telemetry/commit/abc123

lee_sre: Alerts set. I'll be on-call for the window.

tanya_eng: Migration patch ready, running canary tonight.

alex_cost: Spend alert created.

sam_ops: Thanks team — postmortem template will be in the thread after the window. :thumbsup:

lee_sre: One more note — if we see NIC flaps >3x on a rack, we pivot to a hardware replacement workflow instead of repeated reboots.

sam_ops: Copy. We'll log hardware replacement candidate racks in the runbook.

maintenance-bot: m-azn3-2026-03-31 status: scheduled.
